en.g: Use have been + -ing for actions that started in the past and are still going on.
p: Form: have/has been + -ing. I've been studying all morning. She's been working here since May.
It stresses the activity and its duration: We've been waiting for twenty minutes.
It can explain present results: I'm tired because I've been running. Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?
en.q: Welcome to B1! What have you been doing lately to improve your English?
en.c: Write four sentences about things you've been doing this week: I've been reading, I've been cooking...

en.g: Ask and answer about duration with for, since and how long.
p: Question: How long have you been learning English? How long has she been living here?
For + a period: for two years, for ages. Since + a starting point: since 2019, since I was a child.
State verbs like know, like or have use the simple form: I've known her for ten years, not I've been knowing.
en.q: How long have you been learning English, and how long have you been living where you live now?
en.c: Write three true answers with for and three with since about your hobbies, home and friends.

en.g: Use the past perfect to show which past action happened first.
p: Form: had + past participle. When I arrived, the film had started. She had already eaten.
It sets the order: the earlier action is in the past perfect, the later one in the past simple.
Useful words: already, just, never, before, by the time. I had never seen snow before that trip.
en.q: Think of a time you arrived late. What had already happened when you got there?
en.c: Write three sentences with When I arrived... + had: When I got to the station, the train had left.

en.g: Guide your listener through a story with clear time connectors.

Finish: eventually, finally, in the end. In the end, we laughed about it all evening.

en.c: Retell a film or book you like in six sentences, using at least five different connectors.

en.g: Imagine unreal or unlikely situations with if + past, would + verb.
p: Form: If + past simple, would + base verb. If I had more time, I would learn to paint.
It is about now or the future, but imaginary: If I won the lottery, I'd travel the world.
With be, were is common for all persons: If I were rich, if she were here. I'd = I would.
en.q: If you had a free year with no work or study, what would you do with it?
en.c: Finish five sentences: If I could fly..., If I lived abroad..., If I were a chef..., If I had a robot..., If I spoke ten languages...

Abilities: I wish I could sing. I wish I could speak Japanese. Be: I wish I were taller.
If only is stronger: If only it were the weekend! Keep it light and positive.
en.q: What is one thing you wish you could do, and one thing you wish you had right now?
en.c: Write five wishes: two about skills (I wish I could...), two about your life and one about the weather.

en.g: Choose between a real possibility and pure imagination.
p: First: If + present, will. Real and likely: If I see him, I'll tell him. If it rains, we'll stay in.
Second: If + past, would. Unreal or unlikely: If I were you, I'd go. If I had wings, I'd fly.
Same idea, different feeling: If I get the job, I'll move (possible). If I got the job, I'd move (less likely).
en.q: What will you do if the weather is nice this weekend? And what would you do if you had a whole month off?
en.c: Write two pairs of sentences on the same topic: one first conditional and one second conditional each.

de.g: Du wählst zwischen echter Möglichkeit und reiner Vorstellung.
p: First: If + Present, will. Real und wahrscheinlich: If I see him, I'll tell him. If it rains, we'll stay in.
Second: If + Past, would. Unwirklich: If I were you, I'd go. If I had wings, I'd fly.
Gleiche Idee, anderes Gefühl: If I get the job, I'll move (möglich). If I got the job, I'd move (weniger sicher).
de.q: Was machst du, wenn das Wetter am Wochenende schön ist? Und was würdest du mit einem ganzen freien Monat machen?
de.c: Schreib zwei Satzpaare zum selben Thema: jeweils einen Satz mit First und einen mit Second Conditional.

Misma idea, otra sensación: If I get the job, I'll move (posible). If I got the job, I'd move (menos probable).
es.q: ¿Qué harás si hace buen tiempo este fin de semana? ¿Y qué harías si tuvieras un mes entero libre?
es.c: Escribe dos pares de frases sobre el mismo tema: en cada par, una con first y otra con second conditional.

en.g: Use the second conditional to talk about dream jobs and other lives.
p: Dream job: If I could do any job, I'd be a wildlife photographer. I'd travel and work outdoors.

en.g: Report what people said, usually moving the tense one step back.
p: Say vs tell: She said (that) she was tired. He told me (that) he would come. Tell needs a person.
Backshift: am to was, will to would, can to could, have done to had done. I'm busy becomes she said she was busy.
Change words: I to he/she, here to there, today to that day, tomorrow to the next day.
en.q: What is something nice a friend or colleague said to you recently? Report it with said or told me.
en.c: Report five things people said today or yesterday: My mum told me that... My friend said that...

de.g: Du gibst wieder, was jemand gesagt hat, meist mit einer Zeitstufe zurück.
p: Say oder tell: She said (that) she was tired. He told me (that) he would come. Tell braucht eine Person.
Zeitverschiebung: am zu was, will zu would, can zu could. I'm busy wird zu she said she was busy.
Wörter anpassen: I zu he/she, here zu there, today zu that day, tomorrow zu the next day.
de.q: Was Nettes hat dir neulich ein Freund oder Kollege gesagt? Gib es mit said oder told me wieder.
de.c: Gib fünf Dinge wieder, die Leute heute oder gestern gesagt haben: My mum told me that... My friend said that...

es.g: Cuenta lo que alguien dijo, normalmente retrocediendo un tiempo verbal.

Cambio de tiempo: am a was, will a would, can a could. I'm busy pasa a she said she was busy.
Cambia palabras: I a he/she, here a there, today a that day, tomorrow a the next day.
es.q: ¿Qué cosa bonita te dijo hace poco un amigo o un compañero? Cuéntalo con said o told me.
es.c: Cuenta cinco cosas que alguien dijo hoy o ayer: My mum told me that... My friend said that...

Concordance : am devient was, will devient would, can devient could. I'm busy donne she said she was busy.
Adapte les mots : I devient he/she, here devient there, today devient that day, tomorrow devient the next day.
fr.q: Quelle gentillesse un ami ou un collègue t'a-t-il dite récemment ? Rapporte-la avec said ou told me.
fr.c: Rapporte cinq choses dites aujourd'hui ou hier : My mum told me that... My friend said that...

it.q: Qual è una cosa gentile che un amico o un collega ti ha detto di recente? Riferiscila con said o told me.
it.c: Riferisci cinque cose dette oggi o ieri: My mum told me that... My friend said that...
